releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.204: Home Screen Widget Settings now offers ten independently selectable shortcuts: My Diary, Personal Calendar, Smart Reminder, New Note, My Kharcha, My Documents, My Memories, Private Locker, Favourite Notes, and World Clock. The widget shows exactly the selected shortcuts; the date can be toggled separately. Existing purple/gold raised 3D buttons, individual press feedback, responsive content height, and Left–Right plus Upper–Neeche resizing are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web bundle update. Existing saved data and app identity are preserved.
